links.outcome: Concordance of AI treatment recommendations with tumor board on local historical patients, by stage
links.effect: Overall concordance 86.96% (280/322); stage I 96.93%, stage II 88.89%, stage III 90.91%, stage IV 45.83%. Age, performance status and stage IV independently reduced concordance.
links.quote: The concordance rates for stages II and III were 88.89% and 90.91%, respectively, which were close to 90%; however, the concordance rate for stage IV was the lowest at 45.83%.

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing treatment recommendations generated by Watson for Oncology to Multidisciplinary Tumor Board decisions to evaluate concordance.
